fullTextZH: 每个人都有他们害怕的东西
fullTextEN: Everyone has something they are afraid of.
Some people might be afraid of the dark.
Some people might be afraid of ghosts.
Some people might be afraid of snakes.
Some people might be afraid of dogs.

fullTextZH: 我害怕的这个东西啊，它的嘴巴很长
fullTextEN: The thing I am afraid of, its mouth is very long.
It can make sounds and also fly.

fullTextZH: 你知道我害怕的这个东西是什么吗
fullTextEN: Do you know what this thing I am afraid of is?

fullTextZH: 我怕的这个东西呀，是鸟

fullTextZH: 为什么Bella老师会害怕鸟啊
fullTextEN: Why is Teacher Bella afraid of birds?
Today, Teacher Bella will tell you

fullTextZH: 我为什么害怕鸟的小故事
fullTextEN: the little story of why I am afraid of birds.

fullTextZH: 我的妈妈常常去她的朋友家
fullTextEN: my mom often went to her friend's house.
This friend's house is very big.

fullTextZH: 朋友家的前面有一个很大的地方
fullTextEN: In front of the friend's house, there is a very large area.
And then this place, you know,

fullTextZH: 火鸡就是这个很大的鸟
fullTextEN: Turkeys are these very large birds.

fullTextZH: 然后火鸡的脖子前面有这样子的东西
fullTextEN: And then in front of the turkey's neck, there is something like this.

fullTextZH: 我的妈妈带我一起去她的朋友家
fullTextEN: My mom took me to her friend's house.
My mom opened the door and got out of the car.
I opened the door and got out of the car.

fullTextZH: 这些火鸡慢慢的慢慢的向我走过来
fullTextEN: These turkeys slowly, slowly walked towards me.
At that time, I was very short.

fullTextZH: 这些火鸡都在我的旁边
fullTextEN: These turkeys were all beside me.

fullTextZH: 他们发出咕噜咕噜的声音

fullTextEN: Then their necks are very long.
Eyes wide open looking at me.

fullTextZH: 好像在说这个小孩看起来很好吃
fullTextEN: As if saying this child looks delicious.
At that time, I was very small.
Then I started to scream and cry.
I was not eaten by the turkey.
Recently, there was also an incident,
that made me even more afraid of birds.

fullTextZH: 有一天，我和我的朋友一起去了公园
fullTextEN: One day, my friend and I went to the park together.

fullTextZH: 我和我的朋友看到觉得很好吃
fullTextEN: My friend and I saw it and thought it looked delicious.

fullTextZH: 所以我们也想去买这个越南面包
fullTextEN: So we also wanted to buy this Vietnamese sandwich.

fullTextZH: 我和我的朋友就买了越南面包
fullTextEN: My friend and I bought the Vietnamese sandwich.

fullTextZH: 这个时候我发现了一只鸟在上面
fullTextEN: At that moment, I noticed a bird above.
This kind of bird is called a seagull.

fullTextZH: 你常常会看到这种鸟在海边
fullTextEN: You often see this kind of bird by the sea.
Maybe you think seagulls aren't big,

fullTextZH: 可是我因为太害怕鸟了
fullTextEN: but I am very afraid of birds,
The seagull is also looking at me.

fullTextZH: 所以啊，我告诉了我的朋友
呃，我们去其他的地方吧
这只海鸥飞过来拿了我的食物
fullTextEN: This seagull flew over and took my food.

fullTextZH: 我很快的把面包丢到别的地方
fullTextEN: I quickly threw the bread somewhere else.

fullTextZH: 这只鸟也开始吃着我的面包
fullTextEN: This bird also started eating my bread.

fullTextZH: 因为我真的非常的害怕
fullTextEN: Because I was really very scared.
